steps.title: Grow Wheat Plants
steps.instruction: Grow wheat plants in a growth cabinet until the second leaf emerges (approximately 7-9 days).

substeps.instruction: Fill a 10cm diameter pot 3/4 full with medium-grain potting mix without fertiliser.
Sprinkle 10 to 20 seeds on top and fill pot to just below the rim.
Move to growth cabinet set at 21°C with 16 hr days.
Place pots in a shallow black tray and dampen mix with water mixed with complete soluble fertiliser (Hortico brand, complete mix – 1 scoop/1L), filling the tray to approx 3cm below the rim.
Check plants at day 5 and top-up with plain water.

steps.title: Prepare Reagents
steps.instruction: Prepare necessary solutions and materials for the day of use.

substeps.instruction: Prepare PEG-Ca solution (shake vigorously to dissolve PEG); make fresh each day and do not reuse.
Thaw 5% BSA.
Prepare modified W5 (W5 + 1 mM glucose).

steps.title: Isolate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Extract protoplasts from wheat leaves using enzyme digestion.

substeps.instruction: Add 10 mL of filter sterilised 0.6 M Mannitol to a 7 cm petri-dish.
Use a blunt razor to make a shallow cut in the abaxial or adaxial epidermis and peel the epidermal layer off.
Place the leaf, peeled-side down in the Mannitol for 10 to 20 mins.
Add 10 mL of freshly made enzyme solution to another 7 cm petri-dish.
Transfer leaf peels from mannitol to the enzyme solution using tweezers.
Wrap the petri-dish in foil and incubate in the dark at room temperature on an orbital shaker (horizontal movement at 60 RPM) for three hours.
Gently tap/swirl the dish to release protoplasts until leaves appear transparent.

steps.title: Purify and Concentrate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Filter and wash the protoplasts to reach the required concentration.

substeps.instruction: Add 5 mL of W5 solution to a petri dish.
Remove leaves from enzyme solution with tweezers, lifting up and down to release trapped protoplasts.
Place a cell strainer in the petri-dish lid, wet with 1 mL of W5, and filter the protoplast solution.
Transfer filtered protoplasts via funnel to a 30 mL plastic round-bottomed tube and add 5 mL of W5.
Gently swirl to mix until homogenous.
Pellet at 100 x g for 3 mins.
Carefully remove supernatant without disturbing the pellet.
Add 15 mL of W5.

Estimate concentration using a haemocytometer (Recommended: 5 µL protoplasts and 20 µL W5; add 8 µL to each side). Calculation: total cells = (average cells of 4 squares) x 10,000 x initial volume x dilution factor.
Incubate on ice in the dark for 40 mins to 1 hr until protoplasts settle.
Remove supernatant and adjust concentration to 300,000-350,000 protoplasts/mL using MMG.

steps.title: Prepare Plasmid DNA
steps.instruction: Prepare the DNA aliquots for transfection in round-bottom tubes.

substeps.instruction: Thaw plasmid DNA, flick and spin tubes to ensure homogeneity.
Freeze/thaw each aliquot no more than three times.
If plasmid is viscous, heat at 65°C for 10 min.
Dispense required amounts into tubes (typically 20 µg reporter plasmid and 10-15 µg of Avr/R plasmid) using new tips for each.

steps.title: Transfect Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Perform transfection using either manual pipetting (Option A) or an electronic multichannel pipette (Option B).

substeps.instruction: Option A (Manual): Pre-load a pipette with 300 µL PEG (use wide bore or cut tips). Resuspend protoplasts by swirling. Add 300 µL protoplasts to DNA tubes, swirl, and quickly add 300 µL PEG. Swirl to homogenise.

Option B (Electronic): Set pipette to 'protoplasts300' program. Dispense protoplasts, PEG, and W5 into reservoirs (add 10% extra volume). Pipette 300 µL protoplasts and mix, eject tips, then pipette 300 µL PEG and mix (up and down 3x slowly).
Incubate all transformations for 15 minutes.
Add 900 µL of W5 to stop the transformation.
Pellet protoplasts at 100 x g for 2 mins.
Remove as much supernatant as possible without losing protoplasts.

steps.title: Incubate Protoplasts
steps.instruction: Plate the transfected protoplasts for reporter expression.

substeps.instruction: Coat wells of a sterile 12 or 24 well cell culture plate with 5% BSA (filter sterilised) by adding 1 mL to the first well and transferring sequentially.
Resuspend protoplasts in 500 µL of modified W5 (W5 + 1 mM glucose).
Add to the culture plate using wide bore or cut tips.
Incubate for 4 to 16 hours in light at room temperature.

steps.title: Perform Luciferase Assay
steps.instruction: Analyze reporter expression using a dual luciferase assay.

substeps.instruction: Transfer well contents to 2 mL tubes and centrifuge at 300 x g for 3 min at RT.
Add 200 µL 1x lysis buffer, vortex, and incubate for 15 min.
Centrifuge again at 300 x g for 3 min at RT.
Add 50 µL of lysate into a white, opaque bottom 96 well plate.
Set plate reader for dual luciferase reading (e.g., Corning flat white plate).
Add 50 µL luciferin (Promega Steady-Glo) with a multichannel pipette, pipetting in/out 2 times to mix.
Incubate for 5 mins.
Read using luminometer (1000 ms integration, 0 ms settle).
For ratiometric assay, select red and green filters immediately following total luminescence measurement.

steps.title: Analyze Data
steps.instruction: Process the luminescence data using deconvolution calculations.

substeps.instruction: Perform deconvolution calculations using measurements from red and green filters via spreadsheet template or Python script.
Calibrate deconvolution constants if necessary according to the Promega Chroma-Glo™ Luciferase Assay System Technical Manual (page 9).
